about: Allure & Beauty by Andrea is the practice of Andrea Salazar, a licensed esthetician based in Fort Myers, FL (filed as Allure & Beauty by Andrea LLC in July 2021 per Sunbiz/Corporationwiki search results). Andrea specializes in skincare, permanent makeup and lash services, and is also a SkinPen ambassador per her Instagram bio. She currently sees clients for facials, Hydrafacial, microneedling, chemical peels, dermaplaning and lash/brow work through a shared provider booking system for 'Sharma Plastic Surgery' in Fort Myers (where she is listed as provider 'Andrea Salazar, ME'), and separately offers permanent makeup (microblading, ombre powder brows) through a second host med-spa, Hideout Boutique. Her Google Business Profile / Yelp / Birdeye listing for 'Allure & Beauty by Andrea' independently shows a perfect 5.0 rating across 42 reviews.
about_source: Corporationwiki/Sunbiz search snippets (LLC filing date), multiple WebSearch summaries describing Andrea as founder/licensed esthetician with skincare+PMU+lash specialization, Instagram bio (SkinPen Ambassador line), and the PatientNow/Hideout Boutique booking payloads confirming her as the real provider behind those services.

images.curation_note: Only 2 unique real photographic assets survived curation from the only accessible channel (Andrea's personal Instagram): one genuine finished/flattering client result (used twice, in two different crops, across hero and gallery) and one owner portrait (used once, small, as an avatar). This is well below the pipeline's normal 6-14 target. Per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 rule 2 ('mejor menos secciones con buenas fotos que rellenar con malas'), the Experience section's 2-photo grid was replaced with a real-review pull-quote card, and the Gallery section was reduced from 6 tiles to 1 real photo tile + 1 honest 'follow on Instagram for more' CTA tile, rather than padding either section with duplicate, unflattering or unverifiable images. All images visually inspected one by one; no selfies or owner portraits used as gallery tiles; no closed-eyes/mid-procedure/extraction shots; no text-overlay screenshots anywhere on-site.
images.resize_note: All 4 final assets are at or under 1000px on their long edge (max source width 480px from Instagram's own delivered size, well under the resize ceiling; no upscaling performed) and were saved as quality ~88 JPEGs via PIL.

brand_vibe: No dedicated business branding exists (personal Instagram account, no logo, no styled business photography). The one usable real photo is warm, bright and skin-forward (soft daylight, clean light background, gold jewelry, glowing complexion), and the business spans facials/skincare, lash and permanent makeup for a feminine, glam-adjacent but still 'quiet luxury' clientele. A light base with a berry-blush/rose accent (rather than a colder or darker palette) fits this best: warm cream background, deep berry-rose accent for CTAs and headlines, dusty rose mid-tone, soft blush secondary surface.
